products.short_description: Stand up a real Software Asset Management program — the SAM lifecycle, roles and RACI, SOPs and workflows, KPIs, and ITIL v4 alignment, so software is governed from request to retirement. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stand up a real Software Asset Management program — not just a spreadsheet

Most organizations 'do SAM' as scattered spreadsheets and last-minute audit panic. There is no defined lifecycle, no owners, no KPIs, and no repeatable process — so compliance is luck and savings are left on the table. This solution stands up a real Software Asset Management program: the SAM lifecycle, roles and RACI, SOPs and workflows, KPIs, and ITIL v4 alignment, so software is governed deliberately from request to retirement.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the SAM lifecycle (request → entitlement → deployment → reconciliation → renewal/retirement), roles and RACI, the tooling landscape, and ITIL v4 alignment.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (an entitlement system of record, discovery data, a request/intake channel, named owners, executive sponsorship) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define scope and roles, stand up the system of record and intake, author SOPs and workflows, set KPIs and reporting, run the first governance cycle, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — SAM-readiness discovery, process/data-coverage validation, a SAM KPI and maturity report, safe remediation of data gaps, and a SAM-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A deliberate, governed SAM program — defined lifecycle, owners, SOPs, and KPIs — replacing spreadsheet chaos and audit panic, proven on a pilot scope before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SAMPROG-Discovery.ps1 — Software Asset Management program readiness and data-coverage discovery
    • SAMPROG-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation of SAM data gaps in the entitlement register
    • SAMPROG-Report.ps1 — render the SAM KPI set, a maturity snapshot, and an Effective License
    • SAMPROG-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the SAM pilot/expansion scope group in Microsoft Entra
    • SAMPROG-Validation.ps1 — confirm SAM-program process and data coverage for a scope

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
